projects.title: StudioBoard
projects.description: A collaborative workspace for planning projects, sharing progress, and keeping small teams aligned.
projects.longDescription: StudioBoard brings planning, ownership, status updates, and team discussion into one responsive workspace. Its component-driven interface keeps common actions consistent while a structured API supports projects, members, and activity history.
metrics: Unified planning, updates, and ownership in one workspace

projects.title: InsightFlow
projects.description: An analytics dashboard that turns uploaded operational data into readable trends and summaries.
projects.longDescription: InsightFlow guides a dataset from upload through validation, cleanup, exploration, and visual reporting. The workflow emphasizes understandable charts, traceable transformations, and exportable summaries for teams that need useful answers without navigating raw tables.

projects.title: VisionAssist
projects.description: A computer-vision workspace for organizing images and reviewing model predictions in context.
projects.longDescription: VisionAssist connects image preparation, model inference, confidence review, and human feedback in a single workflow. A lightweight API separates model execution from the review interface, making experiments easier to compare and uncertain predictions easier to inspect.
metrics: Human review workflow for model predictions

projects.title: SensorGrid
projects.description: A monitoring console for connected devices, live readings, alerts, and fleet health checks.
projects.longDescription: SensorGrid receives device telemetry over MQTT, streams current readings to the interface, and highlights devices that need attention. Grouped fleet views and alert states turn a continuous sensor feed into an operational picture that works across desktop and mobile screens.
metrics: Live device health and telemetry visibility

projects.title: QueuePilot
projects.description: An event-processing service designed around reliable background jobs, retries, and clear observability.
projects.longDescription: QueuePilot accepts asynchronous work, processes jobs through retry-aware workers, records each outcome, and exposes concise health information. The design focuses on predictable failure handling and enough operational context to understand what is queued, running, completed, or blocked.
metrics: Retry-aware processing with visible job status

projects.title: CloudLaunch
projects.description: A deployment toolkit for repeatable application releases, environment validation, and release checks.
projects.longDescription: CloudLaunch organizes build validation, environment configuration, infrastructure changes, deployment, and post-release verification into a repeatable pipeline. The toolkit makes release steps explicit so failures can be located quickly and successful deployments can be reproduced across environments.

blogPosts.title: Building a Small Component System Without Overengineering
blogPosts.summary: A practical outline for introducing reusable interface patterns while keeping a growing codebase understandable.
blogPosts.content:
This is temporary article content for previewing the long-form reading experience.

A useful component system begins with repeated product needs, not an abstract inventory. Start with a small token layer, document interaction states, and keep composition flexible.
